local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local function verifyArtworkFace(part,face,asset)
 assert(part and part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Transparency<1,'art host missing or hidden')
 assert(type(asset)=='string' and asset~='','configured art missing')
 local images,decals=0,0
 for _,d in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
  if d:IsA('SurfaceGui') and d.Face==face and d.Enabled then
   for _,image in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
    if image:IsA('ImageLabel') and image.Visible and image.ImageTransparency<1 and image.Image==asset then images+=1 end
   end
  elseif d:IsA('Decal') and d.Face==face and d.Texture==asset and d.Transparency<1 then decals+=1 end
 end
 assert(images==1 and decals==1,'expected one visible image and decal on '..tostring(face)..' for '..asset)
 return true
end

for _,face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Front,Enum.NormalId.Back}) do verifyArtworkFace(root.Polish['City Decor']['DNA Lab Compact Sign'],face,G.GeneratedGraphics.Iteration02DNABanner) end
assert(root.Walls['Titan Server Wall']:GetAttribute('NextAttackAt')==0,'idle Titan countdown armed') return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,dnaBothFaces=true,idleCountdown=0})

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local function assertContained(container,object)
 assert(object and object:IsA('GuiObject') and object.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and object.AbsoluteSize.Y>0,'missing rendered rectangle')
 local a,b=container.AbsolutePosition,container.AbsoluteSize local p,s=object.AbsolutePosition,object.AbsoluteSize
 assert(p.X>=a.X-1 and p.Y>=a.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=a.X+b.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=a.Y+b.Y+1,'rendered bounds outside safe host: '..object.Name)
end
local function effectivelyVisible(object)
 local node=object while node do if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end node=node.Parent end return true
end
a:Invoke('OpenTab','Pets') task.wait(.5) local inv=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') assert(inv.ok and inv.visible and inv.category=='Pets' and #inv.visibleKeys>=1,'Pets does not open real Inventory')
local folder=assert(workspace:FindFirstChild(p.Name..' Client Companions')) local model=assert(folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model')) local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local def
for _,item in ipairs(G.Pets) do if item.name==model:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName') then def=item break end end assert(def,'unknown companion definition')
assert(model:GetAttribute('PetVisualIdentity')==def.templateName and model:GetAttribute('PetTemplate')==def.templateName,'equipped pet lost actual imported identity')
local parts=0 for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then parts+=1 assert(d.Anchored and not d.CanCollide and not d.CanTouch and not d.CanQuery and d.Massless,'companion physics flags unsafe') elseif d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or d:IsA('JointInstance') or d:IsA('Constraint') or d:IsA('BodyMover') or d:IsA('Animator') then error('companion behavior hazard '..d.ClassName) end end assert(parts>0,'empty companion')
local distance=(model:GetPivot().Position-p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude assert(distance>=2 and distance<=8,'companion spacing outside follow band')
a:Invoke('SelectInventoryItem',inv.visibleKeys[1]) task.wait(.2) local selected=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') assert(selected.selected and selected.selected.previewPet==def.name and selected.selected.equipped,'selected inventory identity/equipment mismatch')
local window=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory assert(effectivelyVisible(window),'actual Inventory invisible')
return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,companion=def.name,template=def.templateName,parts=parts,distance=distance,inventory=true})

steps.label: unavailable task rewards communicate WAIT

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation
local events=game.ReplicatedStorage.PunchWallEvents local response local connection=events.Feedback.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(v) if v.target=='Quest' then response=v end end)
local good,err=pcall(function() events.ActionRequest:FireServer({action='ClaimQuest'}) local deadline=os.clock()+4 repeat task.wait(.04) until response or os.clock()>deadline assert(response and response.type=='Fail','early Quest did not reject') end) connection:Disconnect() assert(good,err) return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,kind=response.type,target=response.target})
